mercury.determination: Mercury is not denominator- or floor-limited. Its raw adjacent defects are oppositely phased; after either phase alignment the residual remains coherently larger in the fine pair. Radial and transverse position plus radial velocity all have ratios above one.

orbital_elements.equinoctial: NOT_APPLICABLE: no repository equinoctial implementation exists at preregistration.

definitions.barycentric_rule: Preserve each lane's stored barycentric Sun position and velocity. Reconstruct each non-Sun body's heliocentric state and add that lane's Sun state.
definitions.mean_anomaly_aligned: For both members of each pair preserve each lane's a,e,i,Omega,omega and replace M with the matched 0.25-day M.
definitions.mean_longitude_aligned: For both members preserve each lane's a,e,i,Omega,omega and set M=wrap(lambda_0p25-Omega_lane-omega_lane).
definitions.pair_reference: The common phase is always from the 0.25-day lane for both the 0.5/0.25 and 0.25/0.125 comparisons.
definitions.reporting: Report both methods without selecting a preferred result; calculate raw and stripped RMS, adjacent ratios, RTN components, and 1-squared_stripped/squared_raw. Negative removed fractions are retained.

definition.epoch_selection: all 10000 matched noninitial epochs; t=0 is excluded from every new defect aggregate
definition.fractional_body_contribution: sum of the body's six scaled squared defects divided by the full-system sum over the same selected epochs
definition.global_scaled_rms: sqrt(mean over selected epochs and all 10 bodies of (sum(position_delta/AU)^2 + sum(velocity_delta/(AU/Julian_year))^2)/6)
definition.position_scaled_rms: sqrt(mean of the three Cartesian position_delta/AU components)
definition.velocity_scaled_rms: sqrt(mean of the three Cartesian velocity_delta/(AU/Julian_year) components)

smallest_next_step: Preregister two 100 kyr full-M0 controls at 0.25 and 0.125 day under one preselected alternative WHFast configuration. Compare their coordinate-free nonphase defects with the frozen baseline prefixes and with existing IAS15 only over its validated 10 kyr overlap. Use the result only to decide whether that configuration warrants qualification; do not assume 0.125 day or the alternative configuration is preferable.
